assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks and known sick sinus syndrome.

Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
This service is supported by diagnosis codes G45.9, I49.5, and R42, and is required to evaluate the symptomatic episodes in this patient.
